technical_issue.description: Device or software malfunction, bug, crash, freeze, battery drain, or update error
examples: My iPhone keeps restarting randomly every few minutes
The screen is frozen and won't respond to touch
Battery draining extremely fast after updating to iOS 17
technical_issue.agent_action: Troubleshoot with diagnostic steps and device restarts

account_access.description: Apple ID, iCloud sign-in problems, password reset, two-factor authentication, or activation lock
examples: I cannot sign into my iCloud account on my Mac
Forgot my Apple ID password and security questions
Two-factor verification code is being sent to my old disabled number
account_access.agent_action: Guide customer through official Apple account recovery procedures

billing_inquiry.description: Charges, refunds, App Store subscriptions, Apple Pay, or unauthorized transactions
examples: I was charged $9.99 for a subscription I cancelled last week
How can I request a refund for an accidental App Store purchase?
There is an unauthorized pending charge from Apple on my bank statement
billing_inquiry.agent_action: Explain billing policies or direct to reportaproblem.apple.com

how_to.description: Feature configuration, setup instructions, settings, and usage guidance
examples: How do I transfer photos from my iPhone to my Windows PC?
Where is the toggle to turn on dark mode?
How do I set up Face ID on my new iPad?

hardware_repair.description: Physical damage, screen crack, water damage, hardware replacement, AppleCare claims, or Genius Bar bookings
examples: Dropped my phone and the screen is completely cracked
My speaker sounds distorted and crackly after getting wet
How do I book an appointment at the Genius Bar to replace my battery?
hardware_repair.agent_action: Provide repair options and direct to support.apple.com/repair

product_compatibility.description: Inquiries regarding device compatibility, accessory support, or product specifications
examples: Does the 1st gen Apple Pencil work with the 10th gen iPad?
Will this USB-C charger fast charge my iPhone 15?
Is my older MacBook Air compatible with macOS Sonoma?
product_compatibility.agent_action: Verify hardware/software specs and provide official compatibility details

service_complaint.description: Customer frustration regarding poor service, long wait times, or bad repair experiences
examples: I have been waiting 4 days for someone to reply to my ticket
Your store technician was rude and refused to honor my AppleCare
This is unacceptable customer service from a trillion dollar company
service_complaint.agent_action: Acknowledge frustration, apologize sincerely, and escalate for manual handling

other.description: General greetings, praise, spam, or ambiguous inquiries outside standard support scope
examples: Thanks for the help, everything works now!
Apple makes great products
Can I ask a question here?
other.agent_action: Politely acknowledge, close the loop, or ask for clarification
